I need to get the output down to a single line of JSON with no markdown, so I'm going through the candidates one at a time. The first is the "Mediterranean type" glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, which fits the specific-disease category, and I'll keep its leading quote as it appears in the span. The second candidate, favism, is where I'm picking up next.

Next I'm weighing favism, a specific disease with a hemolytic reaction to fava beans. The hemolytic anemia candidate is a broader class of several specific diseases, so it gets the disease-class label. The G6PD variants, Mediterranean, Athens-like, Union, Betica and Menorca, all look like specific diseases.

I'm now looking at whether the bare "G6PD" mention, in the phrase about characterizing the deficient G6PD variants, names a disease at all. On its own, G6PD is the enzyme's abbreviation, so I'm leaning toward no entity for that candidate. I'll settle the last candidate on that basis.

I'm marking G6PD deficiency as a specific disease, then the remaining G6PD variants (Mediterranean, Betica) and favism as well. For the bare "G6PD" mention I'm leaning toward no entity, since on its own it names the enzyme rather than a disease.
